blind_case: A maintainer of a dual-use automation tool removed the original public distribution channel following reported third-party misuse. The maintainer could stop future official releases but could not demonstrate revocation of earlier copies. An external investigator reported misuse; downstream effect and victim recovery are unknown.
questions: Separate confirmed release withdrawal from unverified downstream revocation.
Assess audit and recovery options without inferring motive.
Retain strongest counterexample that fewer future releases may lower risk.
